{{nihongo|'''Co-Enshrinement of Ohoyamamitano Shrine Ronsha 5'''|神明神社（合祀）}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Echizen Province]].
